brief: Place multiple buy-now-pay-later instalments on one payment calendar.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Instalment Calendar"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Combina cuotas en un calendario"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Junte parcelas num calendário"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Place multiple buy-now-pay-later instalments on one payment calendar.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Small instalments from separate purchases can fall together; place every due payment on the same calendar before checking available money.
instruction.misconception: Each small instalment is affordable independently, so their combined schedule does not matter.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Place each plan’s payments on their dates, then add payments sharing a date. Compare the combined schedule with available money.
Plan A starts before plan B on this calendar.
The combined calendar retains every payment from both plans.
Both instalments need funding on the same day.
Friday income arrives after Tuesday’s payments are due.
Older unpaid plans remain part of the combined commitment.
Monday needs both payments, while Thursday keeps its own payment.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
